intake: Learning activity, engagement analytics, pseudonymous IDs of minors

A random learner ID that LearnTech creates for each learner. No name, e-mail address, age, school or image is sent; the table that links each ID to a learner stays in LearnTech's student data warehouse.
Teachers, learners and parents see the progress dashboards in the LearnTech learning platform.

Lumen runs the analytics application, its database and the servers under them in its own cloud account. LearnTech sets up the dashboards, who may sign in (through LearnTech's single sign-on) and which data is shared. No LearnTech code or servers run there.
